rtdb.config/environment-platform.rationale: Compiled only for hosts that are neither Unix nor Windows, which RTDB does not ship for; the JVM reads the environment through System.getenv on every platform it runs on.
rtdb.config/environment-platform.reference: No reference equivalent: platform build guard.

rtdb.conformance/column-table-fixture-ty.rationale: Conformance control fixture rejects column types it cannot construct; never reached by a node.

rtdb.conformance/slt-format.rationale: sqllogictest record formatting in the conformance harness.

rtdb.conformance/slt-harness-gap.rationale: sqllogictest engine reports records the harness cannot drive.

rtdb.conformance/slt-symbol-value.rationale: sqllogictest engine cannot render symbol result cells.

rtdb.expr/async-required.rationale: Only the synchronous expression API rejects a reached nonzero SLEEP. Query operators evaluate through evaluate_async, and static DML expansion excludes volatile expressions (rust/crates/tx/src/submission.rs:51), so SQL and XTQL SLEEP never reach it.
rtdb.expr/async-required.reference: core/src/main/clojure/xtdb/expression.clj sleep codegen blocks the calling thread; RTDB suspends instead.

rtdb.expr/regex-host-form.rationale: The reference splices the raw XTQL regexp-replace pattern form into generated code and evals it, so any Clojure host form runs. RTDB interprets a bounded subset of pure forms; full parity needs a Clojure interpreter and would carry the reference's code-injection behaviour.

rtdb.format/decimal-metadata.rationale: Rejects malformed or conflicting internal decimal precision/scale field metadata in Arrow IPC; the JVM never writes such metadata.
rtdb.format/decimal-metadata.reference: No reference equivalent: RTDB-internal IPC metadata keys.

rtdb.format/metadata-flavour.rationale: Statistics are only grouped for numeric, temporal and duration columns once presence and byte-backed columns have returned; any other Arrow type here is an internal invariant breach.
rtdb.format/metadata-flavour.reference: core/src/main/kotlin/xtdb/metadata column metadata flavours (numbers, date-times, times-of-day, durations, bytes).

rtdb.format/non-byte-bloom.rationale: Bloom insertion is only called for Utf8/Binary/FixedSizeBinary columns (rust/crates/format/src/statistics.rs:140); a non-byte cell is an internal invariant breach.
rtdb.format/non-byte-bloom.reference: No reference equivalent: the JVM hashes the same byte-backed vectors.

rtdb.format/storage-version.rationale: Refuses storage written under an unknown storage version; not called on a production read path at this revision.
rtdb.format/storage-version.reference: No reference equivalent: the reference roots storage at Storage/VERSION and does not read other versions.

rtdb.metrics/cloudwatch-not-compiled.rationale: Build-feature guard: a server built without the cloudwatch feature cannot open a CloudWatch publisher.
rtdb.metrics/cloudwatch-not-compiled.reference: No reference equivalent: the JVM module is selected by classpath.

rtdb.metrics/missing-step-provider.rationale: Default trait method for providers without step accumulation; the production metrics Registry overrides sample_step (rust/crates/metrics/src/lib.rs:159).
rtdb.metrics/missing-step-provider.reference: No reference equivalent: Micrometer step registries.

rtdb.node/prepared-session-statement.rationale: pgwire, Flight SQL and ADBC route session-control statements through the control parser before preparing; statements outside the grammar now report xtdb/sql-error.
rtdb.node/prepared-session-statement.reference: core/src/main/antlr/xtdb/antlr/Sql.g4:16 directlyExecutableStatement; non-grammar statements are xtdb/sql-error parse failures (core/src/main/kotlin/xtdb/query/SqlParser.kt:29).

rtdb.query/boolean-setter.rationale: BOOL_AND/BOOL_OR/EVERY over non-boolean emitted types: the reference reducing aggregate has no vector setter for them and throws.

rtdb.query/min-max-setter.rationale: MIN/MAX into decimal, small or unsigned integer, half-float or time vectors: the reference reducing aggregate's output vector has no matching setter and throws.

rtdb.query/small-integer-sum.rationale: SUM into a byte or short accumulator: the reference Sum vector has no sumInto implementation for those widths.

rtdb.query/variance-input.rationale: VAR_*/STDDEV_* over inputs other than int, long or double: the reference squareInto is only implemented on those vectors.

rtdb.tls/unsupported-identifier.rationale: CA certificate URI names with a named IPv6 interface scope or a trailing-dot host are resolved by the JDK's URIName against the host's interfaces and resolver; the result depends on the JVM host.

rtdb.tx/removed-operation.rationale: Historical xtql/call transaction legs are decoded for replay but cannot be re-encoded as source operations; the reference no longer has these operations.
rtdb.tx/removed-operation.reference: No reference equivalent at the pinned revision: xtql and call tx-ops were removed.

rtdb/arrow-type.rationale: Arrow types with no XTDB vector mapping (LargeUtf8, views, large lists, ...) in stored files or client batches.

rtdb/decimal-width.rationale: Decimal logical types must be 32, 64, 128 or 256 bits wide to map onto Arrow decimal storage.

rtdb/encoded-union-leg.rationale: Run-end-encoded legs inside dense unions are rejected; XTDB unions carry plain legs only.

rtdb/jvm-half-float.rationale: Half-precision floats: the reference vector factory errors on FloatingPoint HALF.

rtdb/run-end-type.rationale: Null, bottom and nested run-end layouts have no Arrow run-end encoding.

rtdb/too-many-union-legs.rationale: Arrow dense-union type ids are a signed byte, so a union holds at most 127 legs.
rtdb/too-many-union-legs.reference: Arrow columnar format: dense union type ids are int8.

rtdb/unknown-arrow-extension.rationale: An Arrow extension name outside the XTDB set in a stored file or client batch has no logical type.
rtdb/unknown-arrow-extension.reference: No reference equivalent: the JVM ExtensionTypeRegistry leaves unknown extensions as their storage type.

xtdb.azure/credential-selector.rationale: AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS values outside the DefaultAzureCredential set; the Java Azure SDK rejects them with IllegalArgumentException at credential construction.

xtdb.expression/non-literal-interval-met.rationale: Interval constructor field/precision arguments are produced as literals by the SQL planner; a non-literal reaches the reference codegen with a nil :literal and fails.

xtdb.expression/non-literal-precision.rationale: SQL grammar only admits an unsigned-integer precision; a non-literal XTQL precision fails the reference assertion.
xtdb.expression/non-literal-precision.reference: core/src/main/clojure/xtdb/expression/temporal.clj:1721 (assert (integer? precision) "precision must be literal for now").

xtdb.expression/non-literal-temporal-fie.rationale: SQL EXTRACT/DATE_TRUNC fields are keywords in the grammar; a non-literal XTQL field reaches the reference with a nil :literal and the field case throws IllegalArgumentException.

xtdb.expression/non-literal-timezone.rationale: The SQL DATE_TRUNC timezone is a character-string literal in the grammar; a non-literal XTQL timezone reaches ZoneId/of with nil and throws.

xtdb.expression/range-bins-unit.rationale: Zoned RANGE_BINS inputs at a unit other than microseconds fail the reference assertion.

xtdb.expression/set-equality.rationale: = and <> between two sets throw UnsupportedOperationException in the reference.

xtdb.expression/transit-throwable-text.rationale: Printing an ExceptionInfo transit value embeds the JVM construction stack trace, which a native implementation cannot reproduce.

xtdb.expression/unsupported-round-type.rationale: ROUND(smallint/tinyint, scale): the reference case only maps :i32 and :i64 to a decimal precision and throws IllegalArgumentException otherwise.

xtdb.pgwire/unsupported-binary-type.rationale: Binary-format parameters of duration, oid, regclass or regproc: those PgTypes do not override readBinary.

xtdb.pgwire/unsupported-value-operation.rationale: Result encodings a PgType does not implement.

xtdb.postgres/unsupported-json-ld-value.rationale: JSON-LD xt:timeZone, xt:period, xt:symbol, xt:table, xt:type and xt:field decode to JVM objects with no Arrow vector type, and unknown types are rejected by the decoder.

xtdb.postgres/unsupported-map-key.rationale: Maps with non-string, non-keyword keys have no document type.

xtdb.postgres/unsupported-pgoutput-messa.rationale: pgoutput message tags other than R, Y, B, C, I, U and D.

xtdb.postgres/unsupported-symbol.rationale: Symbols have no Arrow vector type.

xtdb.postgres/unsupported-text-type.rationale: Text values of oid, regclass or regproc columns: those PgTypes do not override readText.

xtdb.postgres/unsupported-transit-value.rationale: Transit tags that decode to JVM objects without an Arrow vector type.

xtdb/col-meta-type.rationale: Stored column-metadata type descriptors outside the encodable set.
xtdb/col-meta-type.reference: No reference equivalent: RTDB column-metadata encoding.

xtdb/fixed-database-catalog.rationale: Ingest nodes have a fixed database set and no query surface; the reference refuses attach/detach there too.
xtdb/fixed-database-catalog.reference: core/src/main/kotlin/xtdb/api/IngestNode.kt:70-84 FixedDbCatalog error("can't attach a database to an ingest node").

xtdb/sql-unsupported.rationale: All 66 binder sites are sqlparser-rs dialect constructs that Sql.g4 has no rule for, grammar alternatives that sql.clj has no visitor for or explicitly throws on (window names and frames, ranking windows, a second window function, CTE column aliases, schema-qualified wildcards, DISTINCT on non-distinct aggregates), or branches that RTDB pre-processing makes unreachable (RETURNING, LIKE ANY, session control). The reference reports most of these as an incorrect xtdb/sql-error parse failure, where RTDB reports unsupported.

xtdb/unknown-function.rationale: Evaluator fallback after planning: plan typing rejects unknown functions with xtdb.expression/function-type-mismatch, or types them null/bottom so evaluation returns before the fallback.

xtdb/unsupported-run-end-type.rationale: Null and bottom have no run-end encoding.

xtdb/unsupported-type-rendering.rationale: Unsigned integers and half floats have no JVM type EDN rendering; the reference vector types never contain them.
